mission.title: Igikorwa cy'ikirere
mission.addPhotoScan: Fotora icyo kintu — AI irakubwira niba kibora.
mission.storyHint: Wakoze iki, kandi wumvise umeze ute?
mission.privacy: Ifoto y'igikorwa cyawe ni ibanga — ni wowe wenyine uyibona.

mission.celebrateBody: Igikorwa cyawe cyabitswe mu rugendo rwawe.

scan.title: Suzuma
scan.heroBody: Fotora ikintu kimwe. AI ya EcoFun irakimenya ikakwereka uko wakijugunya neza mu Rwanda — hanyuma ubone amanota iyo ukijugunye neza.
scan.bioExamples: Ibisigazwa by'ibiryo, ibishishwa, amababi, impapuro, ibiti
scan.nonBioExamples: Pulasitiki, ibirahure, ibyuma, batiri, ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga
scan.bioExplainer: Ibi birabora ubwabyo. Bishobora kuvamo ifumbire aho kujugunywa.
scan.nonBioExplainer: Ibi ntibibora. Bibike ukwabyo kugira ngo byongere gukoreshwa cyangwa bitunganywe — ntuzigere ubitwika.
scan.uncertainExplainer: AI ntiyabashije kumenya imyanda igaragara neza. Ongera ufotore ikintu kimwe hafi kandi ahari urumuri.
scan.analysingBody: AI ya EcoFun irareba ifoto yawe
scan.disclaimer: Ibi ni ikigereranyo cya AI — kurikiza amabwiriza y'akarere kawe ku myanda.
scan.noneBody: Suzuma ikintu cya mbere ukibone hano.
scan.tip1: Inama: igishishwa cy'umuneke kibora mu byumweru bike.
scan.tip2: Inama: icupa rya pulasitiki rishobora kumara imyaka irenga 450.
scan.tip3: Inama: u Rwanda rwaciye amasashe mu 2008.
scan.tip4: Inama: ntugatwike pulasitiki — umwotsi wayo ni uburozi.
scan.disposeBody: Bishyire mu kintu gikwiye cyo kujugunyamo imyanda, mu ifumbire cyangwa aho bakusanyiriza, ubifotore nk'ikimenyetso. AI ya EcoFun irabigenzura.
scan.disposeHint: Erekana ikintu ugishyira mu kintu gikwiye
scan.disposeRejected: Ntitwabonye ikintu kijugunywa. Ongera ufotore neza, igikoresho cy'imyanda kigaragara.
scan.disposedToast: Ni byiza cyane! +{} amanota kubera kubijugunya neza.

camera.none: Nta kamera iri kuri iyi telefoni.
camera.permissionBody: EcoFun ikeneye kamera kugira ngo imenye imyanda kandi ibike ibikorwa byawe.

community.pointsInfo: Ubona amanota iyo abandi bahaye ifoto yawe inyenyeri: amanota 1 kugeza kuri 5 kuri buri wese.

community.alreadyRated: Wamaze gutanga amanota kuri iyi foto.
community.noComments: Nta gitekerezo kiratangwa. Ba uwa mbere!

history.title: Urugendo rwanjye
history.emptyBody: Ibikorwa warangije bizagaragara hano hamwe n'amafoto n'inkuru zawe.

profile.noJourney: Rangiza igikorwa cya mbere utangire urugendo rwawe.
profile.signOutConfirm: Ushobora kongera kwinjira igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
profile.deleteConfirm: Ibi bisiba burundu konti yawe, amanota, amafoto n'amateka.
profile.about: EcoFun · Ibikorwa birengera ikirere mu Rwanda. Amakuru ava kuri Taarifa, Green Africa, KT Press, Rebero, Umuseke na Izuba.
profile.emailUpdatesOn: Uzajya ubona imeyili igihe ugeze ku minsi myinshi ikurikiranye.
profile.emailUpdatesOff: Imeyili z'iminsi ikurikiranye zahagaritswe. Iz'umutekano zo zizakomeza kuza.

admin.intro: Shimira umunyamuryango ku gikorwa yakoreye hanze ya porogaramu. Buri gihembo kirabikwa.
admin.pointsMessage: Andika umubare usanzwe kugira ngo utange amanota, cyangwa ufite akamenyetso ka - kugira ngo uyakureho.
admin.reasonMessage: Umunyamuryango azabona iyi mpamvu mu imenyesha rye.
admin.suspendMessage: Arasohorwa, ntashobora kwinjira, kandi ntagaragara ku mafoto no ku rutonde kugeza ukuyeho ihagarikwa.
admin.deleteMessage: Ibi bisiba burundu konti, amafoto, inkuru, ibyasuzumwe n'amanota. Ntibishobora gusubizwa.
admin.adminProtected: Konti z'abayobozi ntizishobora guhagarikwa cyangwa gusibwa.
admin.announceIntro: Ohereza ubutumwa ku banyamuryango bose. Buhita bugaragara mu imenyesha ryabo.
admin.emailFooter: Imeyili zigera ku banyamuryango bafunguye “Amakuru kuri imeyili”. Gmail yohereza imeyili zigera kuri 500 ku munsi.
admin.settingsFooter: Konti z'abayobozi ntizishyirwa ku rutonde rw'amanota.
